scoreBefore.style: A chill, reggae-infused track built on a steady, laid-back drum machine groove and a deep, melodic bassline. Clean electric guitar plays classic off-beat reggae skanks, while subtle organ pads provide harmonic texture. The male lead vocal, delivered in a relaxed and melodic French Creole, is treated with spacious reverb and delay, with layered harmonies reinforcing the chorus. The song features a brief, melodic saxophone solo over the main groove before concluding with an instrumental section that highlights the core rhythm and fades out., 136 bpm, G major, 4/4 time
